name: Nirvana
description:
Nirvana brings your GTD workflow into Claude. Capture whatever's on your mind, clarify it into the right list — Next, Waiting, Scheduled, or Someday — and organize by the real-world contexts where things actually get done, like @home, @errands, or @calls.

Ask "What's on my Next list?", "What can I do while I'm out running errands?", or "What am I waiting on?" Add tasks on the fly, reschedule what slipped, tag by context, star, or mark things done. Run your Weekly Review with Claude — clear your inbox, review every list, and get current.

Built for focus, not overwhelm — Claude helps you capture, clarify, and reflect while Nirvana keeps your whole life in order.

Requires a Nirvana account. Reads and writes your tasks, projects, and tags.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nirvana to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nirvana to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nirvanahq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nirvana MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nirvana provides these MCP tools: create_tasks, get_tags, get_task_counts, get_tasks, and update_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nirvana?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Nirvana in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Nirvana requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nirvana is developed by Nirvanahq, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
